cases.title: Registry has the 11 documented numeric sensors with documented units + DTC
cases.input: REGISTRY.all()
cases.expected: ids and units equal the control-file table (G)

cases.title: Every sample of a normal 155 s trip: finite numeric values, correct units, AVAILABLE
cases.input: SimulationSource seed 4100 normal, all samples x 11 sensors
cases.expected: 776 samples, step 200 ms, contiguous sequence, no bad type/unit/quality
cases.actual: samples=776 steps=[200] seq_contiguous=True bad_type=0 bad_unit=0 bad_quality=0

cases.title: Simulation output -> validated sample -> Session -> SQLite is value-exact for all samples
cases.input: Session over SimulationSource seed 4100; compare 776x11 values with measurements table and with an independent regeneration
cases.expected: 0 mismatches, max |difference| = 0 (no rounding applied by the pipeline)

cases.title: Validator: missing/unsupported/unit/range/stale/duplicate/backward timestamps
cases.input: crafted samples through DataQualityValidator
cases.expected: MISSING and UNSUPPORTED stay explicit (never 0 or AVAILABLE); wrong unit and out-of-range flagged; stale flagged; duplicate and backward rejected; NaN/Inf/bool refused

cases.title: Declared relations hold in every sample of 4 normal trips (cold/warm/scale 0.86/1.14)
cases.input: MAF=RPM*(0.002+0.00008*load); MAP=30+0.65*load (100 at rpm 0); voltage 13.7-14.1 V running and 12.4 V stopped; load 0 when stopped; cold coolant monotonic
cases.expected: 0 violations over 4 x 776 samples

cases.title: Plausible couplings: throttle~load, speed~rpm in acceleration, load~MAF, idle rpm, trims bounded
cases.input: correlations on a cold normal trip
cases.expected: corr(throttle,load)>0.9; corr(speed,rpm | accel)>0.99; corr(load,MAF)>0.9; idle rpm 800-820; |STFT|<=2; LTFT 1.2-1.8
cases.actual: corr_thr_load=0.990 corr_speed_rpm_accel=0.9999 corr_load_maf=0.920 idle_rpm=811.5 stft=[-2.00,2.00] ltft=[1.500,1.800]

cases.title: Same seed reproduces all readings; different seed changes noisy signals
cases.input: seed 777 twice, seed 778 once
cases.expected: identical for same seed; RPM differs in >50% samples for another seed

cases.title: Trip length follows duration (0..60 s at 200 ms = 301 samples; no gaps)

cases.title: Direction of the effect matches each scenario's definition

cases.expected: S01 coolant up; S02 MAF down; S03 short trim up; S04 MAF biased; S05 voltage down
cases.actual: {"S01 coolant rises >10 C": [true, {"n": 174, "max_abs": 38.028, "mean_delta": 29.811}], "S02 MAF lower than baseline": [true, {"n": 174, "max_abs": 2.796, "mean_delta": -2.112}], "S03 short trim positive": [true, {"n": 174, "max_abs": 16.186, "mean_delta": 15.485}], "S04 MAF biased": [true, {"n": 174, "max_abs": 4.009, "mean_delta": -3.228}], "S05 voltage drops": [true, {"n": 175, "max_abs": 3.247, "mean_delta": -2.378}]}
